title: reading the room
system_instruction_addendum: READING THE ROOM ADDENDUM: Walk through reading the energy curve mid-set. Suggest next-track adjustments grounded in what just played.

tutor_speak.text: play your current set. i'll narrate the energy curve as it builds and drops.
when i hear the room asking for a shift, i'll suggest a next track from your queue.

hints.text: keep your queue open. i'll point to a track when the energy moves.
if you disagree with a suggestion, ignore it. trust your ear.
tap continue when the lesson feels done.
